Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: Although PRIDE metadata lists 'Top-down proteomics' as an experiment type, the detailed sample processing protocol explicitly describes a bottom-up workflow: proteins were digested with trypsin and peptides were analyzed by LC-MS/MS. Therefore, proteomics_mode is set to Bottom-up. The assay is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) to identify the NUPR1 interactome.

organism: search against the human protein proteome of the swissprot database
cell_lines: MiaPaCa-2 cells were obtained from American Type Culture Collection (ATCC, USA)
Cell death induced by ZZW-115 treatment of pancreas cancer-derived cells
scope: NUPR1-associated proteins were then identified by mass spectrometry

Lysates from MiaPaCa-2 cells (transfected with NUPR1-Flag or NUPR1-GFP) were used for immunoprecipitation, performed with agarose beads coated with anti-Flag or anti-GFP antibodies. After immunoprecipitation, the eluted proteins were analyzed by LC-MS/MS.

Equal amounts of total protein were used to incubate with 30 μL of anti-Flag M2-coated beads (MilliporeSigma, F3165) or GFP-Trap Agarose (Chromotek, GTA-10). Beads were then washed 3 times, and proteins were eluted
